gpt.text: Zomaj Hauc is the Izzet magelord whose mana bomb, dropped at Uncle's request, goes awry and creates the Schism while mutating the plague.

Kos and the others find Hauc trying to hatch three dragon eggs to destroy the Guildpact, and he orders them killed, but Teysa breaks into the Cauldron and has Pivlic administer cures so the dragons cannot breathe.
A dragon awakens and Hauc commands it, while Teysa reads Crix's spell to command the last dragon, and in a dogfight Hauc dies as the two dragons kill each other.
At Kos's funeral, Hauc's spirit awakens, hearing the voices of other spirits.
